feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Alberta votes to remain part of Canada
articles.summary: Alberta ‌has voted to remain part of Canada in the province's first-ever referendum on separation.

articles.title: Australian MP loses leg after car 'reversed to hit her a second time'
articles.summary: An Australian MP has had a leg amputated after a man allegedly drove into her and reversed to hit her a second time.

articles.title: Trump's approval rating hits new record low as US midterms loom
articles.summary: Donald Trump's approval rating has fallen to a record low - indicating that next month's midterm elections could be punishing for the Republicans.

articles.title: Japan launches mission to Mars to bring back samples from its moon
articles.summary: Japan launched a spacecraft towards Mars in a ground-breaking mission to bring back samples from the largest of the planet's two moons.

articles.title: King Charles 'sends books about soil' to Aung San Suu Kyi
articles.summary: Myanmar's detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi has been photographed receiving books and letters from the King Charles, officials said.

articles.title: Object thought to be Amelia Earhart’s missing plane likely just 'large trees', researchers find
articles.summary: An expedition to investigate if an anomaly seen on a satellite image of a remote island in the South Pacific was Amelia Earhart’s missing plane has ended without recovering the wreckage.

articles.title: UEFA writes to FIFA demanding answers on Trump-Infantino dealings
articles.summary: European football chiefs have sent a list of 42 questions to FIFA, demanding answers about Gianni Infantino's alleged "conflicts of interest" over business dealings with the Trump family and the World Cup sell-off attempt.

articles.title: UN cuts food aid to half a million Gazans over funding shortages
articles.summary: The UN World Food Programme (WFP) has said it is being forced to "drastically reduce" aid to Gaza because of funding shortages.

articles.title: Doomsday cult leader found guilty of murdering 190 children and one adult
articles.summary: Doomsday cult leader Paul Mackenzie, his wife Rhoda Maweu, and 29 other co-accused have been found guilty of the murder of 190 children and one adult.

articles.title: Wargame with a difference as Russia faces dilemma
articles.summary: Mutiny erupts in the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad in an uncomfortable test for the Kremlin.
